caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with a lid and two rounded knobs on top for handling. The box is rendered in shades of brown, indicating a wood grain texture along all visible surfaces. Each side of the box features upwardly curved extensions at both ends, with the extensions forming prominent, symmetrical scroll-like shapes. The front and back panels show subtle wood grain patterns, and the box corners are visibly joined with interlocking, stepped joints. The lid fits closely over the box and the two knobs are evenly spaced near either end. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects present. There is a small handwritten inscription in red near the bottom left corner.
title: Dough Trough
